title: Multitud aleatoria bailando (DancerSpawner)
request: Reemplazar los clones de Cytronyx por más gente llamada Dummy: personas aleatorias generadas con IDs de jugadores aleatorios, bailando alrededor de la arena.

operations.source:
-- DancerSpawner — generado por Roblox Agent Bridge (cmd_000006)
-- En Play: genera personas ALEATORIAS de Roblox bailando alrededor de la arena.
-- Ajusta CANTIDAD y RADIO a tu gusto.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CANTIDAD = 14
local RADIO = 38
local CENTRO = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)

math.randomseed(os.time())

local arena = workspace:WaitForChild("Arena")
local dancersFolder = arena:FindFirstChild("Dancers")
if not dancersFolder then
	dancersFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	dancersFolder.Name = "Dancers"
	dancersFolder.Parent = arena
end
dancersFolder:ClearAllChildren()

-- Crea una persona aleatoria real de Roblox (reintenta: algunas IDs ya no existen)
local function crearPersonaAleatoria()
	for _ = 1, 15 do
		local userId = math.random(1, 2000000000)
		local ok, desc = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(userId)
		end)
		if ok and desc then
			local okModel, model = pcall(function()
				return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6)
			end)
			if okModel and model then
				return model
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	return nil
end

local bailarines = {}

for i = 1, CANTIDAD do
	local angulo = (i / CANTIDAD) * math.pi * 2
	local x = CENTRO.X + math.cos(angulo) * RADIO
	local z = CENTRO.Z + math.sin(angulo) * RADIO
	local model = crearPersonaAleatoria()
	if model then
		model.Name = "Dummy"
		model.Parent = dancersFolder
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			root.Anchored = true
			local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
			rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model }
			local ray = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 60, z), Vector3.new(0, -120, 0), rayParams)
			local groundY = ray and ray.Position.Y or CENTRO.Y
			-- R6: los pies quedan 3 studs bajo el centro del root
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, groundY + 3, z))
			local torso = model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			local leftShoulder = torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
			local rightShoulder = torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder")
			table.insert(bailarines, {
				root = root,
				base = root.CFrame,
				fase = math.random() * 10,
				leftShoulder = leftShoulder,
				rightShoulder = rightShoulder,
				leftC0 = leftShoulder and leftShoulder.C0,
				rightC0 = rightShoulder and rightShoulder.C0,
			})
		end
	end
	task.wait(0.1)
end

print(("[DancerSpawner] %d personas bailando"):format(#bailarines))

local t = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	for _, b in ipairs(bailarines) do
		local bt = t + b.fase
		local bounce = math.abs(math.sin(bt * 4)) * 1.2
		b.root.CFrame = CFrame.new(b.base.Position + Vector3.new(0, bounce, 0))
			* CFrame.Angles(0, bt * 1.5, 0)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.sin(bt * 4) * 0.12, 0, 0)
		if b.leftShoulder and b.rightShoulder and b.leftC0 and b.rightC0 then
			b.leftShoulder.C0 = b.leftC0 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(bt * 4) * 1.2)
			b.rightShoulder.C0 = b.rightC0 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -math.sin(bt * 4) * 1.2)
		end
	end
end)
